title: Trial Expiry Banner
description: Time-sensitive decision banner: deadline stated as an absolute date with days remaining, upgrade action with pre-commitment context, cancellation alternative, and renewal terms. Field-tested in task-usability/runs/t5-001 through t5-003.

components.reason: Carries the deadline; states the expiration date in absolute terms with days remaining
The upgrade commitment action; its consequence (plan, price, billing cadence) must be visible before the click
The cancellation or manage-plan alternative; state where it leads
Renewal and cancellation terms, collapsed until requested

nesting: The alert is the banner container; the primary and secondary buttons sit inside the alert's content area (secondary after primary); the terms accordion sits directly below the alert in the same section
validationOrder: Expiration date is stated in absolute terms (e.g. 'on September 29, 2026'), not as a relative countdown alone
Days remaining matches the stated date
The commitment action states its consequence before the click (plan name, price, billing cadence)
The cancellation or dismiss control states whether the choice persists
a11yNotes: Do not rely on color or countdown urgency alone — the deadline is in text
The two buttons are distinguishable by more than styling alone (distinct labels)
Accordion sections remain keyboard operable when the no-JS fallback is preserved
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the warning alert (order 1) and place it as the page's primary message
2. State the expiration date in absolute terms with days remaining inside the alert
3. Add the upgrade button (order 2) with its pre-commitment context (plan, price, cadence) visible before the click
4. Add the cancel/manage button (order 3) and the terms accordion (order 4) when the task includes the decision
5. Verify the deadline statement, the click consequence, and the dismiss persistence before finishing
source: Field-tested: task-usability/runs/t5-001–t5-003 (2026-09-17), trial-expiry banner task; final t5-003 artifact used alert--warning + button + button--secondary + accordion
